::: {.card-grid}

::: {#stepup .project-card .featured data-topics="movement eeg gait"}
[Parkinson's disease · Mobile EEG · Gait]{.kicker}

### [StepuP](stepup.qmd){.stretched} {#h-stepup}

*Steps against the burden of Parkinson's disease.* A JPND-funded trial in six countries that records EEG, EMG and motion capture together to find out why treadmill training improves walking in Parkinson's disease. I lead the Kiel site and run the consortium's multimodal data pipeline.

[JPND · 2023–2026 · shared first author of the protocol]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#metarep .project-card .featured data-topics="meta eeg open"}
[Meta-science · Mobile EEG]{.kicker}

### [META-REP](meta-rep.qmd){.stretched} {#h-metarep}

Within the DFG Priority Programme META-REP, I study the "forking paths" of mobile EEG analysis, with a reporting standard for mobile EEG studies as the cornerstone.

[DFG · SPP 2317 · Oldenburg]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#footplacement .project-card data-topics="gait"}
[Gait · Computational motor control]{.kicker}

### [Where to put the next foot](foot-placement.qmd){.stretched} {#h-footplacement}

Bayesian integration in foot placement control: how noisy estimates of body state and prior expectations combine into the next step. With Moira van Leeuwen and the Amsterdam group.

[VU Amsterdam · ongoing]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#igor .project-card data-topics="open meta"}
[Open science · Community]{.kicker}

### [IGOR](igor.qmd){.stretched} {#h-igor}

The Interest Group on Open and Reproducible Research of the DGPs section Biological Psychology and Neuropsychology. I run its BIDS Consultation Hour and co-lead an umbrella review of EEG/ERP preprocessing.

[DGPs · since 2020]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#eegmanysteps .project-card data-topics="eeg gait open meta"}
[Mobile EEG · Many labs]{.kicker}

### [EEGManySteps](eegmanysteps.qmd){.stretched} {#h-eegmanysteps}

A community-driven, many-labs initiative testing how hardware, setups and pipelines shape gait-related EEG. I am on the steering committee.

[Community · since 2024]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#motion-bids .project-card data-topics="tools open gait"}
[Data standard · Python]{.kicker}

### [Motion-BIDS](../software/index.qmd#bids){.stretched} {#h-motion-bids}

The BIDS extension for motion data, which I co-led, plus *motionbids*, a lightweight Python package for curating motion datasets in the standard.

[BIDS · 2024 · ongoing]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#kielmat .project-card data-topics="tools gait movement"}
[Software · Python]{.kicker}

### [KielMAT](../software/index.qmd#kielmat){.stretched} {#h-kielmat}

The Kiel Motion Analysis Toolbox (formerly NGMT): validated gait and balance algorithms for wearable and motion-capture data from neurological cohorts, built around Motion-BIDS.

[Neurogeriatrics Kiel · JOSS 2024]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#unisep .project-card data-topics="tools open"}
[Data standard]{.kicker}

### [UNISEP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.21159){.stretched} {#h-unisep}

A unified, modality-agnostic framework for describing where sensors are placed on the human body in motion capture and wearable research.

[Preprint · 2024 · co-first author]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#redcap .project-card data-topics="tools open"}
[Software · Clinical data]{.kicker}

### [REDCap workflows](../software/index.qmd#redcap){.stretched} {#h-redcap}

*rcol* installs standardised questionnaires and tests into REDCap; *redcap2bids* turns REDCap exports into BIDS participant files.

[Python · since 2025]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#pocketable .project-card data-topics="eeg tools"}
[Mobile EEG · Smartphones]{.kicker}

### [Pocketable MoBI](https://neuropsyol.github.io/){.stretched} {#h-pocketable}

Low-cost brain and body imaging with smartphones and mobile EEG, developed in the Oldenburg Neuropsychology Lab, applied for example to basketball.

[Oldenburg · 2024–2026]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#epoc .project-card data-topics="eeg"}
[EEG · Post-COVID]{.kicker}

### [EPOC](https://github.com/christianneumannCAU/EPOC-Kiel){.stretched} {#h-epoc}

EEG correlates of post-COVID fatigue and subjective cognitive complaints, a Kiel project I co-supervise.

[Kiel · ongoing]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#electrodes .project-card data-topics="eeg tools"}
[EEG · Computer vision]{.kicker}

### [Electrodes from video](https://github.com/evrim06/video-eeg-electrode-registration){.stretched} {#h-electrodes}

An open-source pipeline that locates EEG electrodes in 3D from a short smartphone video instead of dedicated digitisation hardware.

[Oldenburg · 2025–2026]{.card-meta}
:::

:::

## Earlier projects

::: {.card-grid}

::: {#tremordetect .project-card data-topics="movement tools"}
[Essential tremor]{.kicker}

### [Tremor, feedback and video](https://github.com/JuliusWelzel/tremor_feedback_jw){.stretched} {#h-tremordetect}

How sensory feedback and arousal modulate action tremor, and whether smartphone-compatible computer vision (MediaPipe) can measure tremor from video.

[Kiel · 2021–2025]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#comon .project-card data-topics="gait movement"}
[Neurogeriatrics]{.kicker}

### ComOn {#h-comon}

An exploratory multicentre study of motor, cognitive and mobility deficits in 1,000 geriatric patients before and after routine clinical treatment.

[UKSH · 2017–2023]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#senseage .project-card data-topics="eeg"}
[EEG · Ageing]{.kicker}

### Sense-Age {#h-senseage}

The dynamics of attention: how selective and sustained information processing is controlled, and how it declines with age and cognitive impairment, studied with EEG and attention tests.

[EEG lab, UKSH]{.card-meta}
:::

:::
